purpose: Select the next author for deterministic explicit-speaker extraction so the Joel benchmark can add a second ordinary matched control without another LUAR run or automatic network workflow.

method_decision.novel_remainder: A conservative ranking of candidate speaker labels using already-frozen metadata plus a bounded current public-source screen. No new authorship metric or threshold is introduced.

target_thread_author_census.snapshot_limit: This older census is useful for candidate discovery but is not a complete current overlap authority; public pages may have changed and its target-post set omitted at least one currently visible Joel/Greg shared thread.

selection_rules: Candidate ranking is for acquisition priority only; it does not activate an author role or prove benchmark suitability.
Prefer a stable explicit speaker label with multiple independent same-platform/topic threads and substantial apparently original prose.
Penalize quote-dominated blocks, transcript/import ambiguity, opaque identity labels, thin turns, and uncertain Joel-overlap exclusions.
A fresh complete archive census must replace the older overlap estimate before extraction is admitted.
Admission must use exact source hashes, explicit-speaker extraction, source-group separation, duplicate checks, quotation review, and the existing feasibility gates.
